args.body: Take AUTOMATION-MARKETPLACE-REQUEST-DELIVERY. Change the channel selection: require an explicit paid-work category and a concrete request compatible with installed Node before building. The deliverable is the requested transformation and executed evidence, not another utility site or market report. Stop at the bounded rejection if actual inputs or scope do not qualify. Existing account and payment dependencies affect submission and paid acceptance separately; do not repeat their audits. Feedback remains unknown, revenue unverified, and all existing expiry obligations remain unchanged.

description: The Posit experiment found no qualifying paid request and no installed R runtime; that rejection applies to that channel. Test an explicit automation marketplace for a bounded JavaScript deliverable using the available Node runtime. Feedback remains uncertain: 0 classified and 3 unclassified sources do not establish zero demand. Verified funds and revenue remain zero; submission identity and payment acceptance are separate dependencies.
